info.title: ContrastAPI
info.description: Security intelligence REST API for CVE, package, credential, domain, IP and threat defense lookups, priced in credits.

get.description: Database freshness: CVE/KEV/CWE counts and latest entries, and the sync state of each upstream feed. Costs no credits.

Full CVE record by ID (CVSS, EPSS, KEV, CWE, references, CISA SSVC, Nuclei templates), with the optional GitHub Security Advisory. Call the cve_products tool for every affected product. If your SSVC level is unknown, read high.

parameters.name: cve_id
parameters.description: CVE ID, e.g. CVE-2021-44228

parameters.name: include_ghsa
parameters.description: Add the GitHub Security Advisory of the CVE, from the local copy of the GitHub Advisory Database

post.description: Look up many CVEs at once, each with the fields of cve_lookup. Ids beyond the remaining credits come back in not_processed.

get.description: The products a CVE affects, one page at a time, with the vulnerable products first. The vendor and product arguments keep only the products with that exact name.

parameters.name: cve_id
parameters.description: CVE ID, e.g. CVE-2021-44228

parameters.name: vendor
parameters.description: Exact vendor name, as affected_products writes it

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: Exact product name, as affected_products writes it

get.description: Search CVEs by severity, CWE, CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, ransomware use, Nuclei template, vendor, product and publish date, one page at a time. Call the cve_lookup tool for a full record, and the cpe_search tool to find the names.

parameters.name: cwe_id
parameters.description: e.g. CWE-79

parameters.name: min_cvss
parameters.description: CVSS v3, or v4 when a CVE has no v3

parameters.name: known_ransomware
parameters.description: Only CVEs whose CISA KEV entry notes known ransomware use

parameters.name: has_nuclei_template
parameters.description: Only CVEs with a Nuclei detection template

parameters.name: published_after
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: published_before
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: include_rejected
parameters.description: Also list the CVEs that NVD marks Rejected

get.description: List the CVEs most likely to be exploited, by EPSS score (the probability of exploitation in the next 30 days), with a verdict on the top score. To rank by composite risk score, call the cve_triage tool.

parameters.name: known_ransomware
parameters.description: Only CVEs whose CISA KEV entry notes known ransomware use

parameters.name: has_nuclei_template
parameters.description: Only CVEs with a Nuclei detection template

parameters.name: include_rejected
parameters.description: Also list the CVEs that NVD marks Rejected

get.description: CISA KEV catalog entry for a CVE: the required action, the patch deadline and known ransomware use. A CVE that CISA removed answers in_kev false, and one never listed answers "KEV entry not found".

parameters.name: cve_id
parameters.description: CVE ID

get.description: CWE weakness details (description, mitigations, examples), with how many CVEs and CISA KEV entries name it. To list them, call the cve_search tool with its cwe_id argument.

parameters.name: cwe_id
parameters.description: CWE ID, e.g. CWE-79

get.description: Composite risk score of a CVE, from 0 to 100, for patch priority. It reads EPSS, CISA KEV, Metasploit, CVSS, NVD exploit references and ExploitDB. has_public_poc is null when no source names an exploit.

parameters.name: cve_id
parameters.description: CVE ID

get.description: Public exploit intelligence (GitHub PoCs, Metasploit, NVD exploit references, ExploitDB). GitHub PoC repositories are listed but not counted as proof of a public exploit.

parameters.name: cve_id
parameters.description: CVE ID

get.description: Rank the CVEs of a vendor or product by composite risk score, at or above the optional min_risk_score argument, as lean rows (cve_id, risk_score, label). Call the cve_lookup tool for detail, and the cpe_search tool to find the names.

parameters.name: min_risk_score
parameters.description: Composite risk-score threshold

parameters.name: include_rejected
parameters.description: Also list the CVEs that NVD marks Rejected

post.description: Triage many CVEs at once, ranked by composite risk score. Ids beyond the remaining credits come back in not_processed.

get.description: CVE exposure of one vendor and product: severity, KEV and PoC counts, CVSS, EPSS, the worst risk score, the top CVEs and the endoflife.date support dates. To find the names, call the cpe_search tool.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Product version, e.g. 22.21.1 or 11-24h2; picks the release cycle of eol

parameters.name: include_rejected
parameters.description: Also count and list the CVEs that NVD marks Rejected

get.description: Find the CPE vendor and product names that hold a text, ranked by vulnerable CVE count. Pass a name that holds no % as it is to the vendor and product arguments of the cve_search, cve_triage, cve_leading and product_exposure tools.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Text in vendor or product names, at least 3 bytes; case does not matter, and _ matches a space

get.description: Decode a CVSS v3.0/v3.1 vector into its base metrics and recompute its base, temporal and environmental scores.

parameters.name: vector
parameters.description: CVSS v3.0/v3.1 vector, e.g. CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H

post.summary: Watchlist: CVE, Package, Domain and IP Monitoring
post.description: Add, remove, list or clear the items this API key watches: CVEs, products, CVE searches, packages, domains and IP addresses. Read their changes with the watchlist_events tool. Requires a Pro API key.

action.description: add or remove; leave out to list the items

cve_id.description: For a cve_lookup, kev_lookup or cve_exploit item, e.g. CVE-2021-44228

vendor.description: Vendor, for a product_exposure or cve_search item

product.description: Product, for a product_exposure or cve_search item

min_cvss.description: CVSS v3, or v4 when a CVE has no v3; cve_search items only

min_epss.description: At most three decimals; cve_search items only

domain.description: For a dns_lookup, ssl_check, whois_lookup, headers_check or cert_search item, such as example.com

ecosystem.description: For a package_check item: npm, PyPI, Maven, Go, NuGet, RubyGems, crates.io, Packagist or SwiftURL

name.description: Package name of a package_check item, e.g. lodash

version.description: Exact version of a product_exposure or package_check item; leave out to watch every version

ip_address.description: Public IPv4 or IPv6 address of an ip_lookup item, such as 8.8.8.8, no prefix

clear.description: Deletes every item and the event cursor; takes no other argument

packages.description: package_check items, each with an ecosystem, a name and an optional version

get.description: Report what changed on the items this API key watches, such as a new advisory for a package or a certificate about to expire, oldest first. A plain call continues where the last one stopped. Requires a Pro API key.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Events per call; repeat=true answers the whole last batch

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: next_cursor of an earlier answer; reads after it and keeps the position

parameters.name: repeat
parameters.description: Answers the last batch again; cannot be combined with cursor

get.description: What this server keeps about the caller: the hash its credits are counted under, the rate limit left in this hour and the privacy policy. For a Pro key, which vendor keys are stored and a 15-minute link to change them.

post.description: Save, delete or check your own Shodan and AbuseIPDB keys, which the ip_lookup tool uses. Needs a Pro API key or a manage link. The privacy_my_data tool gives a web link where a person can save the keys without the agent seeing them.

action.description: apply saves or deletes keys; status reports the stored keys and needs link

link.description: The 64 hex digits after #l= in a manage link; leave out to use this Pro API key

shodan_key.description: a Shodan key to check and save

abuseipdb_key.description: an AbuseIPDB key to check and save

get.description: Check a password's SHA-1 against Have I Been Pwned's Pwned Passwords list. It takes the full SHA-1, never the password. Only its first 5 hex digits leave this server.

parameters.name: sha1_hash
parameters.description: SHA-1 of the password: 40 hex digits, either case

get.description: Look up a domain's DNS records: A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, SOA and CAA. A record type the resolver could not answer is listed under unavailable.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domain name, such as example.com

get.description: Check a host name for subdomain takeover through a dangling CNAME. takeover_possible is null when the CNAME points to a service whose DNS does not show whether the name can be claimed.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Host name, such as shop.example.com

get.description: Check a domain's mail authentication: SPF, DMARC (from a parent domain when the domain has no record of its own), DKIM, MX and MTA-STS, each check with pass, warn or fail and a severity.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domain name, such as example.com

parameters.name: dkim_selector
parameters.description: DKIM selector, such as google; without it the check tries the selectors of the domain's mail providers

get.description: Check an e-mail address without sending mail: whether its domain exists and takes mail, and whether a disposable domain list names it. It cannot tell whether the mailbox exists.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: E-mail address, such as name@example.com

get.description: Check the TLS certificate and settings of a host name on port 443: version, cipher, trust, OCSP revocation, expiry, DNS names, the chain and an abuse.ch SSL Blacklist listing.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Host name, such as www.example.com

get.description: Rate nine security headers of a web site, such as CSP, HSTS and Set-Cookie, from one GET to https://<domain>/ that follows up to 5 redirects on the same host or its www pair. Each finding that does not pass has a remediation.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Host name of the site, such as www.example.com

parameters.name: include_full_header_values
parameters.description: true sends each header value and URL whole, instead of cutting it after 500 code points

get.description: Look up a domain's registration over RDAP, or WHOIS where allowed: registrar, dates, status, name servers and DNSSEC. A name under a registered domain asks about that domain. No registrant data.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domain name, such as example.com; www.example.com asks about example.com

get.description: List when the Wayback Machine captured a host's home page: the first and last capture, the years between them and the latest 10 captures with links.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Host name, such as example.com

get.description: List the unexpired certificates that Certificate Transparency logs hold for a host name, wildcards included, from SSLMate's Cert Spotter: the 10 newest, with issuer, validity and DNS names. Costs 2 credits.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Host name, such as example.com or www.example.com

get.description: List up to 50 subdomains of a registrable domain from Certificate Transparency, DNS queries for 94 common names and the domain's MX, NS and SPF records. Costs 2 credits.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domain name, such as example.com; www.example.com asks about example.com

get.description: Look up a public IP address: AS, country, cloud provider, CDN, datacenter or Tor exit, DROP listing and PTR name. A Pro key with its own Shodan or AbuseIPDB key adds exposure and reputation.

parameters.name: ip_address
parameters.description: Public IPv4 or IPv6 address, such as 8.8.8.8 or 2001:4860:4860::8888

get.description: Look up an autonomous system by number, such as AS15169, or by an IP address it holds: name, country and one page of its IPv4 and IPv6 prefixes, derived from IPtoASN.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: AS number, such as AS15169 or 15169, or a public IPv4 or IPv6 address, such as 8.8.8.8

get.description: MITRE D3FEND defenses that counter a MITRE ATT&CK technique. A technique id such as T1055 also matches its sub-techniques. Source: MITRE D3FEND (MIT license).

parameters.name: attack_technique_id
parameters.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique id in upper case, e.g. T1055 or T1055.012

get.description: Look up a Windows driver file hash in the LOLDrivers catalog of vulnerable and malicious drivers. Block on the file and Authenticode hashes, not on the detection rules. Source: LOLDrivers (Apache-2.0).

parameters.name: file_hash
parameters.description: MD5, SHA1 or SHA256 of the driver file, or its Authentihash: 32, 40 or 64 hex digits, either case

parameters.name: include_commands
parameters.description: true adds the catalog's command text to each match

post.description: Look up many driver file hashes in the LOLDrivers catalog at once, each with the fields of driver_lookup. Hashes beyond the remaining credits come back in not_processed.

hashes.description: MD5, SHA1 or SHA256 of driver files or of their Authentihash

get.description: Check a package against the OSV.dev advisories (GitHub, Go, PyPA, RustSec) and the OpenSSF malicious package list, with the fixed version and endoflife.date dates. For severity, pass the CVE aliases to the cve_triage_bulk tool.

parameters.name: ecosystem
parameters.description: npm, PyPI, Maven, Go, NuGet, RubyGems, crates.io, Packagist or SwiftURL. Case does not matter.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Package name as the dependency file writes it, e.g. lodash, @babel/core, org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-core, golang.org/x/net

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Exact version, e.g. 4.17.20; without it every result is listed

post.description: Check many packages at once, each an ecosystem, a name and an exact version, against the advisories package_check reads. For the summary and ranges of an advisory, call the package_check tool.

items.description: Packages, each with its ecosystem, name and exact version

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: The credits the caller may spend in one window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: The credits left in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Reset-Machine.description: The Unix time, in seconds, at which the window resets.

X-RateLimit-Reset-Human.description: The time left until the window resets, as HH:MM:SS.

Error.description: An error. The body names an error code and a message.
